requirement_text:
I want to implement transactional email sending in my ASP.NET Core
application.

Use Resend as the email service provider instead of SMTP.

Requirements:

1. Create an IEmailService abstraction.
2. Create a ResendEmailService implementation.
3. Use the official Resend .NET SDK.
4. Store the Resend API key securely in configuration/secrets.
5. Do not hard-code the API key.
6. Configure the Resend client through dependency injection.
7. Create a SendAsync method that accepts:
   - recipient email
   - subject
   - HTML body
8. Create a method for sending an application-rejected email.
9. When an administrator rejects an application:
   - update the application status
   - save the database changes
   - send the rejection notification email
10. Add proper logging and exception handling.
11. Add a "Send Test Email" API so administrators can verify
    the email configuration.
12. Refactor the existing SMTP Configuration page into a generic
    Email Configuration page for Resend.
13. Do not expose the API key in the UI after it has been saved.
14. Keep the email provider implementation behind IEmailService
    so that SMTP or another provider can be added later without
    changing business logic.
15. Use recipient email address from users table, application table has the userId
16. Explain all NuGet packages, configuration changes,
    dependency injection registrations, database changes,
    controller/API changes, and frontend changes required.
